text: うけて　みるが　よい！

structure.jp: うけて　みるが　よい！
structure.en: go ahead and try taking it!

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means to try doing it and see what happens. うけて　みる = 'try taking it'.

patterns.name: 〜がいい
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by がいい is a lofty way to tell someone to do it; よい is the older form of いい, fitting Koga's old-fashioned speech. うけて　みるが　よい = 'go ahead and try taking it'.
